title: Create a clean, uninterrupted vertical 9
prompt: Create a clean, uninterrupted vertical 9:16 original photograph with absolutely no short-video application interface. Do not include a phone status bar, time, battery indicator, signal icons, menu, profile image, follow button, like, comment, favorite, share controls, numerical counters, username, hashtags, captions, notification box, progress bar, bottom navigation, watermark, platform logo, screenshot border, or any readable text.  Photograph an unmistakably adult woman, approximately 24 to 30 years old, seated at the entrance of a tropical seaside wooden pavilion. Place her near the center of the composition. Her body turns slightly to one side, while her head and upper torso face the camera.  One leg bends high in front of her body, with the thigh and knee close to the camera and filling the central lower foreground. The shin continues diagonally toward the lower-right area. Her other leg folds beside or behind her, revealing a rounded knee and part of the thigh. Because the foreground leg is closer to the smartphone wide-angle lens, it appears subtly elongated, but the anatomy and proportions remain natural.  The hand on frame-left rises beside the ear and lightly touches the hair. Her other hand rests naturally near the knee of the folded leg. Keep her spine mostly upright without stiffness, with a slight shoulder tilt and the raised-hand shoulder sitting a little higher. The foreground leg creates a strong diagonal through the composition.  She looks directly into the lens with a warm, confident, relaxed gaze. Her mouth forms a natural tooth-revealing smile, as though the photographer had just said something that made her smile immediately before the shutter.  Preserve a softly oval face, a relatively narrow but gentle jaw, naturally full cheeks, and balanced eye, nose, and lip proportions. Avoid an extremely pointed chin, oversized eyes, an unnaturally tiny nose or mouth, or a generic over-edited influencer face.  Use a refined translucent makeup style commonly seen in East Asian summer resort portraits and fashion-oriented social imagery: a lightweight luminous base, naturally shaped dark brows, warm brown and peach eye shadow, fine black eyeliner, defined but restrained lashes, subtle apricot blush, and coral nude-pink lips. The frontal light brightens the face while delicate shadows remain around the eye sockets, nose, and jaw.  Give her shoulder-length natural black straight hair with a side part. The ends fall near the collarbones and shoulders. One side rests close to the cheek, while the other forms a gentle inward or outward curve. Keep the hair soft and generally smooth, with slight root volume, mild strand grouping caused by humid seaside air, and a few natural flyaways beside the face and behind the ear. Avoid stiff wig texture or continuous plastic-like highlights.  She wears a rich mustard-yellow, ginger-yellow, or warm golden-yellow spaghetti-strap maxi dress. The upper section has a lightly structured bustier-inspired construction, very thin straps, a gently sweetheart or softly squared low neckline, and visible curved and vertical shaping seams beneath the bust. The textile supports the chest naturally and follows the waist while retaining realistic tension, seams, and small wrinkles.  The skirt has a high side slit and dense side ruching. The seated pose opens the slit naturally, revealing large areas of the thighs, knees, and foreground shin. Long mustard-gold fabric descends along one side of the body, forming vertical folds and pooled sections near the bottom of the frame. A very small pink-and-white floral or soft decorative accent may remain near the slit edge.  Use soft matte or low-sheen draping fabric that responds naturally to gravity, sitting pressure, tension, and gathering. Preserve irregular ruching, compression marks, and folds. Do not turn the dress into sequins, metal, plastic, transparent fabric, a swimsuit, or a short dress.  Add a short white pearl necklace close to the collarbones, small silver-white stud earrings, and several narrow dark or gold circular bangles on the raised wrist. Do not place a smartphone, mirror, selfie stick, camera, or handheld prop inside the image.  Her body is slim and balanced with elongated limbs, a light shoulder and neck line, and a naturally defined waist. The chest is naturally medium-to-full and realistically supported by the structured dress. Do not create an extreme waist or exaggerated anatomy.  Visible skin includes the full face, neck, collarbones, upper chest, shoulders, arms, wrists, hands, large areas of both thighs, both knees, the foreground calf, ankle, and part of the instep. Use light warm-neutral skin that appears creamy beneath frontal light, with subtle peach-pink highlights.  Apply mild smartphone beauty smoothing while retaining fine texture and tonal variation around the knees, elbows, knuckles, and ankles. The skin should look as though it would feel warm, soft, finely textured, and lightly moisturized with a clean satin finish. Avoid wet gloss, oily skin, waxiness, plastic smoothness, or broad overexposure.  Behind her is a tropical wooden pavilion at a seaside hotel, resort, or ocean-view restaurant. Preserve a roughly symmetrical wooden doorway, diagonal support beams, railings, and lattice structures on both sides. Large deep-green palm leaves extend inward across the roof.  A small wooden decorative plaque may remain in the center background, but it should contain only an unreadable abstract white curved shape, never readable lettering or a brand logo. The distant sky is immediately after sunset, with a saturated orange-red glow near the horizon fading upward into dark brown-purple, deep blue-black, and near-black.  Most of the pavilion interior, wooden beams, and palm foliage remain in deep shadow. The foreground is rough stone, exposed aggregate, or pebbled flooring, with the mustard-yellow dress descending toward the lower edge.  Illuminate the subject with a direct smartphone flash or compact LED positioned close to the lens. The subject receives strong neutral-to-warm frontal illumination and appears significantly brighter than the background. Create bright softened highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, cheekbones, collarbones, shoulder peaks, forearms, front thighs, knees, and shin. Retain deeper shadows beneath the jaw, under the hair, below the chest, along the inner arms, between the overlapping legs, and inside the dress folds.  The foreground knee and shin may appear slightly brighter because they are closest to the light, but they must retain believable skin texture and must not become featureless white areas.  Use a smartphone main camera or compact digital camera with an approximately 24 to 28 mm full-frame-equivalent lens. Position the lens in front of the woman at a relatively low height, close to knee level, and tilt slightly upward. Frame from the top of the hair to the foreground leg, ankle, and hanging dress, with the wooden pavilion forming a natural frame around the subject.  Use moderately deep depth of field so the face, foreground leg, dress, wooden pavilion, and palm leaves remain recognizable. Slightly soften the distant sky without exaggerated portrait-mode blur.  Retain authentic low-light smartphone qualities: mild computational sharpening, restrained skin smoothing, strong contrast between the brightly illuminated subject and dark environment, slight digital noise in the shadows, a faint halo around some hair edges, fine side ruching, irregular fabric folds, and rough ground texture. Avoid flawless commercial-advertising polish, neon light, blue rim lighting, anime styling, or CGI rendering.  The orange-red afterglow had already lowered toward the horizon. She had just sat down, arranged the skirt, and lifted one hand beside her ear. The shutter has already fallen, while the sea breeze still seems to be moving the ends of her hair.
